name: Rajesh Kumar
testimonial: Mubeen is one of the most dedicated interns I've mentored. His grasp of Java concepts and ability to quickly adapt to Spring Boot ecosystem was impressive. He consistently delivered quality work and showed great initiative in solving complex problems.

testimonial: Working with Mubeen during the VLSI internship was a pleasure. His understanding of digital design principles and enthusiasm for learning Verilog made him stand out. He has a great future in embedded systems and chip design.
